en: • A dream co-starring of two great Gundams that ran through the Heisei era! ■Newly added MarkingSeal is included. ■God Gundam mode changes by partially replacing it with hyper mode. ■Memorial scene The transformation to atmospheric entry mode is reproduced without replacement. The twin buster rifle firing form is also reproduced. Molded product x 10, foil seal x 2, Tetron seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
